senses.gloss:
मौन मौन, अस्, m. (fr. मुनि), a patro-
nymic; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a dynasty; (ई), f., N.
of the fifteenth day in the dark half of the month
Phālguna, when a ceremony of bathing in silence is
performed; (अम्), n. the office or position of a
Muni or holy sage; silence, taciturnity.
—मौन-
भट्ट, अस्, m. a proper N.
—मौन-मन्त्राव-
बोध (˚र-अव्˚), अस्, m., N. of a work by Sundara-
śukla.
—मौन-मुद्रा, f. the Mudrā or attitude
of silence.
—मौन-व्रत, अम्, n. a vow of silence;
(अस्, आ, अम्), observing a vow of silence, holding
one's tongue; [cf. मुनि-व्रत.]
—मौनव्रत-
धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, or मौन-व्रतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, ob-
serving a vow of silence.
—मौन-सम्मति, इस्, f.
silent assent.

मौनिक, अस्, ई, अम्, resembling a Muni or
inspired sage, like a Muni.

मौनिचिति (fr. मुनि-चित), see Gaṇa Sutaṅga-
mādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.

मौनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, silent, observing silence, taci-
turn, reserved, not speaking; (ई), m. = मुनि, an
ascetic, hermit, holy sage, one who has overcome his
passions and retired from the world; (sometimes at
the end of proper names, e. g. गोपीनाथ-म्˚, the
[]
Muni Gopīnātha.)
—मौनि-त्व, अम्, n. silence,
taciturnity, reticence.

मौनिस्थलिक (fr. मुनि-स्थल), see Gaṇa
Kumudādi 2. to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.

मौनेय, आस्, m. pl. (fr. मुनि), N. of a school;
(आस्), m. f. pl. epithet of a class of Gandharvas and
Apsarasas; (अम्), n. the position or office of a
Muni (Ved.).

मौन्द मौन्द, अस्, m. a proper N.; (also
read मौद्ग, मोद.)
